reviews.title: Do not subscribe—the app is a nightmare, and they trap you in contract
reviews.text:
If you are considering Mindbody, please read this review first and do not make the same mistake I did.

Compared to other modern booking apps that run smoothly and offer immediate customer support, Mindbody is overwhelmingly complex, clunky, and exhausting to manage. What should take minutes turns into a mind-blowing headache.

The worst part is the contract trap. Signing up takes seconds over email, but when you realize the system is virtually unusable for your workflow and ask to cancel, they refuse. There is no cancellation. They demand full payment for the entire remainder of the contract, holding you financially hostage for software that doesn't work for you.

Save your business the stress, wasted time, and money. Look at flexible, month-to-month platforms instead and stay far away from Mindbody.

reviews.title: iPhone ONLY app
reviews.text: iPhone app works well. But this should really have an iPad app it’s 2026. And while you are at it port it to macOS and throw in an Apple Watch app for quickly booking classes from favorites.

reviews.title: Hate the update!!
reviews.text: I HATE the new update that does not show how many people have already signed up for class / how many spots are left!!!! This actively disincentivizes me from signing up or bringing friends to class with me. Please change it back!!!

reviews.title: Bad design. Only functional
reviews.text: First off, it is confusing to find the actual location for the place you are booking.  This app is fine for booking a class once you locate the correct gym. Other than that it is useless. The Reviews section has nothing to do with the particular class you are exploring.  Just random reviews for other classes, other  instructors, other time schedules etc.  Absolutely frustrating.

reviews.title: Worst app ever
reviews.text: More of a workout than the workout, I love class pass, and love the ability to book workouts on an app, this has been the worst experience of my life.  I have a friend who teaches at a studio that uses this app, and if I wasn’t personally invested, and needed to support someone close to me that I love, I would have chosen a different studio.  This app is killing small amazing studios.  Be better.

reviews.title: So so bad
reviews.text: The single worst app I have ever used.  Outrageous in its inefficiency.

reviews.title: Worst app ever
reviews.text: I used the thing once for some yoga class that my sports team did. It had the wrong location set and the people wouldn’t let me in five minutes late to yoga because I had to drive to the other location. Their information is all wrong on Google Maps, and they never responded to my customer support message. I followed up three times to no avail. I wanted to delete my account and they wouldn’t let me. Seriously this app is so terrible. Don’t bother. It will just waste all of your time and then some. If I could rate it zero stars, I would.

reviews.title: Beware the cancellation fees
reviews.text: If you sign up for a class and cancel it the app policy is you get a $15 cancellation fee and lose whatever class pass you used and it doesn’t matter when you cancel If you sign up and 5 mins later cancel it still applies

reviews.title: Hard to find classes
reviews.text: It is so unbelievably difficult to find classes that fit the criteria I’m setting

reviews.title: Stingy about your data, loaded with ads
reviews.text: I only use this because my gym insists. It’s impossible to view your past history or track your fitness passes inside of the app.

reviews.title: Dysfunctional for online classes
reviews.text: This is a pretty solid app for in person bookings, but a total fail for online ones (erm, hello developer. Did you notice that we had a little thing callled COVID a while back and a lot of places started offering hybrid/ livestream options). So if you want to book an online class, at the time of writing you need to go to the  organisation’s webpage and book in the MindBody browser interface. Also, if you are looking at a studio schedule, you may not be seeing their actual schedule because the online only classes won’t show at all. If I was a studio owner and offered online classes, I’d switch to the Momence platform, which is clunky for online class bookings, but can be made to function, whereas MindBody doesn’t work for it at all.😒

reviews.title: Irresponsible app
reviews.text: This service does not take any responsibility or support when their listed vendor is in fact a fraud. You won't be able to get any help or reimbursement even when the vendor is no longer in operation. Even when vendor stops business, this app does not do any proper check on vendor's business status and mislead users. Closed businesses are still shown active, and Mindbody still has transaction opened for them. Even if you are paying through the app with registered card in the wallet, Mindbody cannot do any cancellations even when you haven't received any service from closed vendor. It's a terrible service with no protection for its users. When you use it, be aware of these risks.

reviews.title: Non-intuitive, messy app
reviews.text: Really detest MindBody app. Impossible to delete studios I no longer use; zero customer service, they just refer you back to the studios

reviews.title: Allows insolvent businesses to collect money
reviews.text: If you’re using this App to make payments - check if the listed business even exists. I booked my pilates studio through Mindbody for 3 years. The moment I had my first problem (studio ceasing existence, my money for 10 classes being stuck), the app backs up and says everything to be solved directly with the studio. Ok, but Mindbody don’t even want to take down the ability of the studio to take payments - so people keep bringing money to a business that puts in writing they “ceased existing”. Absolutely irresponsible way of doing business from Mindbody.

reviews.title: Even the website is an ad
reviews.text: Say no to wasting one’s time!

reviews.title: Can’t even sign into the app
reviews.text: It is a major headache that this is the service my yoga studio uses because it takes me 20 minutes to even manage to sign up for classes I have an unlimited membership to because I so frequently get stuck in stupid sign in loops with mind body. I had hoped that the app might be better about that than the browser, except I can’t even sign into the app because *shocker* it gets me stuck in a sign in loop!! I love my studio but I swear to god this app/mind body as a whole is going to put me over the edge one day. I HATE IT. Useless PITA service.

reviews.title: Horrible waiting times not populating anything in my city Evansville in. Can’t load anything.
reviews.text: Can’t find a single class can’t find any businesses in the area. Can’t find any information whatsoever tells me that I can’t enter any information into the location and not searching for businesses is unavailable.

reviews.title: Very buggy
reviews.text: Logged in to check my class booking and it was there, navigate around the app, go back to the homepage and it’s then not showing. It keeps showing in my past activity 0 classes then 16 then back to 0 again - takes for ever to load pages, some never load! Very glitchy

reviews.title: Different prices
reviews.text:
They show  an offer and then when I go to book it’s jumped a dollar or two.  
I don’t deal with shady people or apps, thanks but no thanks.

reviews.title: Class pass expiration date
reviews.text: The app used to display the class pass expiration date before checkout, but that feature is no longer available. This change is inconvenient because we can’t easily determine whether we’ll have enough time to complete our committed number of classes (for example, whether 20 classes must be completed within 3 months or 6 months). Please consider restoring the expiration date visibility before checkout so users can make informed decisions before committing.

reviews.title: Endless Bugs
reviews.text:
I have used mindbody since at least 2020. It is easy to find studios but it’s become harder to book them. 
It seems every other day there is a glitch that forces people to create new accounts despite having accounts or not allowing them to signup ahead of time, view reviews, or class details. What is the point of an app meant to help you reserve a spot ahead of time when it is consistently having bugs that disallow that option. It makes it a very pointless app. The studios I attend can sign me up for the classes I want ahead of time in person and since this app is consistently glitching I will move to that method. 

I also work at a studio using the Mindbody Business platform and we are making plans to leave this company as it constantly creates malfunctions for our clients and an overall dissatisfactory experience for everyone involved with little care, feedback, or action to fix from the Mindbody team.

reviews.title: Make sure you read
reviews.text: If I can give this app a zero I would. The on boarding process it’s not the best. If you decide to cancel, they won’t let you cancel until you talk to somebody and then after you talk to somebody, they refuse to cancel your account unless you pay them $214 probably more depending how far you are in your agreement with them . I literally tried three months to cancel with these people and I have to make time to whenever they wanna talk to me and now they refusing to cancel

reviews.title: Subscription Trap
reviews.text: This app is very easy to use: however, it relies on unethical subscription trap practices. When you buy a pass, there is some fine print noting that packages will autorenew, but you are not given any option to decline or turn off autorenew. Our (wonderful) Pilates studio uses this platform and tells us we have to email them so they can manually go in and turn off autorenew on our accounts! Not having a way to decline or disable autorenew in the app is unacceptable and unethical. I shouldn’t automatically be charged hundreds of dollars to autorenew passes without confirmation!

reviews.title: Kicked out of class
reviews.text: I used Mindbody to join at a studio I’ve been yo dozens of times and just got kicked out of class because Mindybody showed me enrolled but the studio had me as waitlisted. Wasted my time and really embarrassing experience.

reviews.title: Updates remove functionality
reviews.text: Latest update (June 2026) removed the ability to view details of a class if you’re booked in another one during the same time. This is silly if you’re at a studio that has multiple classes running concurrently and you want to keep tabs on enrollment numbers and instructor changes. It also removed the ability to view details (such as prerequisites) for classes level set by the studio. Mindbody also sometimes fails to deliver notifications if a class is cancelled. My studio owner complained they’ve repeatedly tried to get this bug fixed.

reviews.title: Recent change creates a critical bug
reviews.text: Mindbody recently updated their app creating a bug that says that it is not time to book my gym class even though it is time. Then the class fills up before I have a chance to book it. I am now paying a ton of money and cannot book my classes. Please fix!

reviews.title: I hate the new update
reviews.text: The new update took off how many people have booked for a class

reviews.title: Terrible app. Horrible interface
reviews.text: I use MINDBODY because I have no choice. It’s simply the worst app on my phone but my gym gives me no other choice to book classes. All of the positive reviews must be bots. There’s no way anyone likes this app

reviews.title: Frustrating
reviews.text: I had to change my password. The app keeps the old ones even though i typed the new in by hand. My gym has has to keep attempting to link their account to the app and so far nothing is working!

reviews.title: Difficult to cancel passes
reviews.text: I have a month-to-month pass I need to cancel. This should be easy to do within the app. Instead, you have to “contact us” to get it cancelled, and they don’t even provide contact information when you get that message.

reviews.title: Delete my account !!
reviews.text: I’ve been waiting for months!!! To delete my account cause I don’t use it but it keeps pending for admin. ALSO, THEIR IS NO WAY TO CONTACT OR EMAIL THEM?!!

reviews.title: Filtering doesn’t work
reviews.text: Filtering classes makes no sense. You select location, you select a type of class and the time frame, and the list that is given to you puts the classes outside of your interest or time frame first. You change deletion to business instead and then waste a ton of time checking every individual business and find classes that way. So why are they not filtered in to begin with?

reviews.title: Very Glitchy very poorly made app
reviews.text: The app will let me book for myself but will not let me book for registered family members. It keeps asking me to click to agree to the waiver but then says that the waiver agreement was not properly registered. One of the most frustrating apps I have used in a long time. Deeply detrimental to well being and mindfulness.

reviews.text: Integration with Google Calendar!!!!!

reviews.title: Bad costumer service
reviews.text:
I purchased mindbody for my business and then my lease fell through and therefore my business did. 
They would not refund me and even more they charged me to buy out of the contract with me never using it, I didn’t even make it to the set up meeting.

reviews.title: Most glitchy app I’ve ever used
reviews.text: This all only works half of the time. It glitches and doesn’t let me sign up for classes most days. The days where I open it and it does work it feels like a miracle. I’ve also used Mindbody on the business side. The worst software I’ve ever tried. Not intuitive in any way and rarely works.

reviews.title: Violates App Store guidelines and should be removed from App Store
reviews.text: This app forces me to visit their website as soon as I open it, it has no function or utility. Engineering, product managers, and senior management should be made aware that it is not compliant with App Store rules

reviews.title: Terrible UI

reviews.title: Doesn’t take payment

reviews.title: App not working

reviews.text:
Honestly a chore to use the app from start to finish, it is so poorly designed. I can’t use Apple Pay, I can’t use my saved credit card info. I need to manually input every piece of information.

If this is the future I don’t want it
